Package org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728

Class ResultMeta

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728.ResultMeta
@Marshalled public class ResultMeta extends Object
Opaque per-result MCP metadata carried under the JSON-RPC result._meta property.

Every successful v2 result carries server identity under the exact io.modelcontextprotocol/-prefixed wire name mandated by the 2026-07-28 schema. W3C trace-context keys (traceparent / tracestate / baggage) are the schema's explicit exception and remain bare; they are populated only when an enabled tracer echoes the server span context. Unrecognized metadata members round-trip losslessly, in insertion order, through the "*" dynamic-property triplet (extraKeys(), get(String), set(String, Object)).

KEY_SERVER_INFO is the single source of truth for the result-identity wire key; the 2026-07-28 adapter and bean/adapter tests consume this constant rather than repeating the literal string. The W3C trace-context keys are bare and therefore need no analogous constant: RequestMeta centralizes RequestMeta.KEY_TRACEPARENT, RequestMeta.KEY_TRACESTATE, and RequestMeta.KEY_BAGGAGE for the request side of the same carrier.
